meta.name: accessibility
meta.description: Use when working on accessibility, a11y, WCAG, ARIA, screen readers, keyboard nav, focus order, contrast, alt text, captions, reduced motion, or target sizes; not language/culture/device (see inclusive-design).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让网页符合无障碍标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保产品对残障用户友好
copy.tagline_en: Make your web content accessible to all users
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your product meets accessibility standards

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 WCAG 的 POUR 原则（可感知、可操作、可理解、健壮）审查产品可访问性，提供键盘导航、屏幕阅读器支持、颜色对比度、替代文本等具体改进建议。
howto.when: 当任务涉及 WCAG 合规、ARIA、键盘焦点、颜色对比度、替代文本、无障碍表单、时间限制、运动敏感性等，或有人要求“让它可访问”、运行审计时触发。

say.text: 检查这个页面的键盘导航是否正常。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤审查焦点顺序和可见焦点。

say.text: 这个图片应该加什么替代文本？
say.note: Claude 会根据上下文给出具体的 alt 文本建议。

say.text: 帮我做一次无障碍审计。
say.note: Claude 会按快速检查清单逐项审核。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reviews products for accessibility using WCAG's POUR principles (Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, Robust) and gives concrete improvement advice on keyboard navigation, screen reader support, color contrast, alt text, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when tasks involve WCAG conformance, ARIA, keyboard/focus management, color contrast, alt text, accessible forms, timing, motion sensitivity, or when someone asks to 'make this accessible' or run an audit.

say_en.text: Check if this page's keyboard navigation works.
say_en.note: Claude will review focus order and visible focus.

say_en.text: What alt text should this image have?
say_en.note: Claude suggests alt text based on context.

say_en.text: Run an accessibility audit for me.
say_en.note: Claude follows the fast audit checklist step by step.
